claim_boundary: A positive result supports residual/transport coupling in this closed saved-P semantic region. It does not by itself prove a universal operator property.

interpretation_rule.rejects_pairing_mechanism: The shuffled arm leaves accumulated effective-update work unchanged or larger.
interpretation_rule.supports_pairing_mechanism: The shuffled arm materially reduces accumulated gradient and effective-update resultants while the local residual multiset and precast norm remain fixed.

intervention.breaks: residual pairing with head-specific downstream Q/K transport
intervention.operation: fixed cyclic roll of the natural dS residual across 16 attention heads

scientific_question: Does the saved-P local dS residual require its real head-specific backward transport pairing to form accumulated effective-update work?
